doc.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Short time with Basie and Joe Williams as a ballad singer
summary: He was with Basie far less than a year; he knew Joe Williams as a ballad singer in Hampton's band and was surprised by his blues success.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: The Basie band, you were with them what, just about a year?
No, I was with them far less than a year.
Yeah. It was a very short time.
Was Joe Williams on the band at that time? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -7-

No, Joe wasn’t on the band at that time. I met Joe Williams, incidentally the first time I worked with Joe Williams, he was the vocalist with Lionel Hampton’s band. He sang in Lionel Hampton’s band. No blues, he was a ballad singer, and a good one. He sang ballads, beautiful singer. And when he started with the blues in Basie’s band, I was surprised you know, because I knew him as a ballad singer and a really good ballad singer. He still does for that matter.
All of a sudden he’s like the blues man.
Yeah. He is the blues singer of today.
